final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS avg_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), total AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races FROM circuit_counts), top_ten AS (SELECT race_count FROM circuit_counts ORDER BY race_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT c.circuitId, c.avg_round, c.race_count, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_races AS share FROM circuit_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_races IS NOT NULL AND c.race_count >= (SELECT MIN(race_count) FROM top_ten) ORDER BY share DESC
